# Preview release delivery

The reviewed pipeline prepares a draft prerelease for an existing
`vX.Y.Z-preview.N` tag whose version exactly matches Cargo.toml. It does not bump
versions, push commits, publish an APT repository, sign credentials or publish the
draft automatically. No new release is implied by this documentation.

Remote locked tests/builds produce Linux x86-64 and Windows x86-64 binaries.
Linux uses Ubuntu 22.04 (glibc 2.35 or newer); the initial user-local WSL installation target is Ubuntu
24.04 x86-64. macOS/ARM delivery is not verified or supplied by this pipeline.
Each asset is named `proj_<version>_<os>_<arch>[.exe]`, with matching `version.txt`
and `checksums.txt`. Exact-tag help/version/protocol smokes and actual installer
tests must pass before assets enter the draft. Checksums detect corruption and
mismatches; they are not independent signatures or reproducible-build attestations.

Installers default to MiguelRodo/projcli, require version metadata and exactly one
matching SHA256 entry, and verify downloaded bytes before replacement. They stage
on the installation filesystem and need only an existing user-writable directory.
`PROJ_RELEASE_VERSION` pins a release (with optional `v`); preview releases should
always be pinned because GitHub's latest URL normally selects stable releases.
`PROJ_INSTALL_DIR` selects an existing absolute user directory without changing
PATH or system settings. Existing older releases lacking the new metadata fail
closed instead of installing an unverified fallback binary.

Before publication: reconcile reviewed supported behavior and limits, update the
Cargo/Cargo.lock preview version in a reviewed change, verify required checks,
then create the exact reviewed tag. Inspect the resulting draft assets/version/
checksums and retain disposable-project warnings. Publish only after those checks.
For WSL, download the pinned binary/manifest, verify SHA256, preserve any existing
user-local binary, install into the chosen user-local directory and smoke help,
version, capabilities and a disposable configured preview. No local compilation,
sudo, persistent authentication change or R package modification is needed.

Known limits include bounded captured-state recovery, arbitrary external script
effects, incomplete direct R/IDE parity, analysis-free publication retry and broader environment reproduction.
Preview.4 includes the agreed M2/M3 scope described below.

## Verified preview.2 delivery

[0.4.0-preview.2](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/releases/tag/v0.4.0-preview.2)
is published as a prerelease; stable Latest remains v0.3.0. The exact tag/source is
768da1bf1b83be83b657b36219f299f37130ba03. Cargo.toml and the root Cargo.lock
package agree with the CLI's reported version; protocol version is 1. An analysis
project's VERSION remains a separate value.

The [actual-main pinned gate](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/39607431157)
passed full Rust regressions, API documentation, 26 real renderer-policy cases,
eight combined workflows and two production archive witnesses with all seven
corruption probes. Platform tests, installers and the website also passed.
The [exact-tag workflow](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/39607988059)
passed both native binary version/protocol and installer checks.

Both draft binaries matched their platform artifacts. All five public downloads
matched the checked draft bytes, including the exact source/version metadata and
four unique checksum entries. Binary SHA256 values:

| Platform | SHA256 |
|---|---|
| Linux x86-64 | 15e160df722e79fb20af02d46f3858b810a0875a0e53bc0fc05ccf502b52c932 |
| Windows x86-64 | 3c4b7909c5c0669330aff3f1ff4343691da5b02ad962a6346d78330e0f7091ab |

The WSL user-local binary was backed up before replacement. Installed bytes match
the public Linux asset; full-path help/version/capabilities passed. Tiny disposable
Python preview success and deliberate structured failure preserved prior final,
archive and project VERSION bytes while retaining the computed cached result.
The shell resolves the checked user-local command. No local compilation, system
binary replacement, container operation or R-package change was involved.

This historical delivery pinned PROJ_RELEASE_VERSION=0.4.0-preview.2.
The [current install guide](install.qmd) now pins preview.4.
Linux/Windows x86-64 delivery is verified; macOS/ARM binaries remain unavailable.
Bookdown site embedding, direct R/IDE parity, linked-output portability and
M2 records/provenance/retry remain outside the accepted CLI workflow.

The [release checklist](release-candidate.qmd) preserves the review and delivery
sequence for future candidates. The delivered M1 boundary is the configured local
CLI workflow above, including fresh init, ordered explicit file targets and
bounded preservation. Stronger command schemas/process confinement and broader
maintenance audits remain follow-ups. No new runtime or binary change was needed
to reconcile this accepted scope; M2 remains unfinished.


## Verified preview.3 delivery {#verified-preview3-delivery}

[0.4.0-preview.3](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/releases/tag/v0.4.0-preview.3)
is published and installed as the checked WSL user-local command. Its exact
source/tag is95441429fe0ba6779b831ffdf9ad952136a946d0; protocol remains1.
Stable Latest remains v0.3.0.

Independently reviewed preparation [PR196](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/pull/196)
passed all12 exact-head checks. Actual-main
[platform tests](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/40002742829),
[installers](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/40002742874),
[site](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/40002743069) and
[full pinned acceptance](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/40002790620)
passed. Downloaded evidence was checked:26 renderer cases,8 combined workflows,
2 mixed-render recovery cases and production archive/corruption witnesses.

The [exact-tag workflow](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/40003709679)
passed both native binary version/protocol and installer checks. Both artifact
digests and all five draft assets matched CI binaries and exact source/version/
checksum metadata; independent asset review cleared publication. All five
unauthenticated public downloads then matched the verified bytes.

| Platform | SHA256 |
|---|---|
| Linux x86-64 | a3e0bed55933e4bd6e2ca9f43045a07aab862bc67f4cb1a6d4decec7829e4789 |
| Windows x86-64 | ed9f8ff9531fef5a3b90901f0f2eb2bf5a1ffd95d05e83e90326b4ad0d2fcbab |

WSL installation preserved and hash-checked the previous preview.2 binary.
Installed bytes match the public Linux asset; full-path help/version/protocol,
fresh login-shell resolution and tiny disposable Python preview success/failure
checks passed. Exact cached CSV and prior final/archive/project VERSION bytes
were verified. No local compilation, system binary replacement, R/Quarto build,
container operation, credential/access change or existing user data test occurred.

This release includes the [ordinary remote workflow](cli/remote.qmd) and interim
CSV inventories. The [real synthetic GitHub witness](remote-compatibility.qmd#live-github-fixture-verification)
is distinct from this product release: five builds/two restores cover bounded
latest/archive controls; the complete matrix and failures use mocked REST.

Remaining work includes default multi-label restore, individual-file/list-files/
trusted-version conveniences, additional credential/inference parity and local
configured path-append-label:false. Identity/sealing/full provenance, registry
design and CAS-specific discovery/retention are unfinished. Preview.3 is not M2
completion or complete projr compatibility. Existing R package/helpers and thesis
remain unchanged.


## Verified preview.4 delivery {#verified-preview4-delivery}

[0.4.0-preview.4](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/releases/tag/v0.4.0-preview.4) is published as a development prerelease
and installed in the checked WSL user-local location. Exact source/tag: f6f4510a806ea302a2ceee5177707fbde9bed5bf.
The CLI reports preview.4 and protocol1. Stable Latest remains v0.3.0.

Independently reviewed [PR222](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/pull/222)
passed all twelve checks. Its [full pinned acceptance](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/40122746225)
used the identical final release tree: native renderer policies, M1/M2 workflows,
M3 real analysis/backup/recovery and independent Rust byte checks passed. M3 covers
three tree/flat-format recovery cases and nine corruption probes after removing
only disposable working projects. [PR223](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/pull/223)
adds same-project legacy lookup coordination and exact retry preservation; no
multi-project shared-store upload model was introduced.

Final-main [platform tests](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/40123605850),
[installers](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/40123605837) and
[site](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/40123605832) passed.
The [exact-tag workflow](https://github.com/MiguelRodo/projcli/actions/runs/40124525153)
passed Linux/Windows locked tests, actual binary help/version/protocol and installers.
Both binary bytes match tagged artifacts. All five public downloads match the
independently reviewed draft, including four unique checksum entries.

| Platform | SHA256 |
|---|---|
| Linux x86-64 | 31ffa1732f8ee4da9bcf15540a53abeee741a8aca23eeca26f5a94ac6aa8a7f0 |
| Windows x86-64 | 92a5b7626a39f09d78b0661b43e183d8c87c4b382f7e13616bd228121b43a378 |

The old WSL user-local binary was copied to a unique backup before replacement.
Installed bytes match the public Linux asset; help/version/capabilities and fresh
login-shell resolution passed. Tiny Python preview success and deliberate exit17
preserved project VERSION and prior final output while retaining the computed
cache result. No local compilation, container operation, system binary overwrite,
R-package or thesis change was involved.

This completes the agreed M2 and M3 scope, not full projr parity or later milestones.
Stores currently belong to one project. Recovery selects an explicit stored ID;
automatic discovery, GC, performance redesign, permissions restoration, multi-location
transactions and full environment reproduction remain outside this claim. New
GitHub metadata formats have real CLI/mocked REST coverage, not a new live format
round-trip. Ordinary restore remains single-label. Wrappers/IDE parity and richer
initialisation remain separate work. Implementation stops after this M3 delivery.
